input.title: Women's Christmas – Cat Allegedly Embroidered Zip Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

This christmas cat zip up hoodie is for the cat owner whose cat definitely knocked the ornament off the tree, zipped on for tree trimming and the long sweep of broken glass.

A tuxedo cat licks a raised paw beside a smashed red ornament on a braided rug, fir branches and red berries behind it, in black, cream, red and sage with a worn print texture. ALLEGEDLY. runs below it in one huge line of tall condensed capitals: coral on Black and Navy, brick red on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small ALLEGEDLY. wordmark in the same condensed capitals as the back is embroidered on the left chest, and the word OOPS is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest ALLEGEDLY. wordmark and left-cuff OOPS, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the Allegedly. zip hoodie fit?
The Allegedly. christmas cat zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this christmas cat hoodie warm enough for drafty living rooms?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles drafty living rooms, tree-trimming nights and the hunt for the missing ornament well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, the cat above ALLEGEDLY., is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small ALLEGEDLY. wordmark in the same condensed capitals as the back sits on the left chest, and OOPS is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The ALLEGEDLY. wordmark on the chest and the OOPS cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for a cat owner, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the cat owner who knows exactly who broke the ornament. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
